game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Cactus Flats, flats of tall cacti: the sand ranger must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Program Assembler: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order.
theme: Sand Dunes – Cactus Flats: flats of tall cacti
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Route 8: verify the shipment flowchart, trace an extra input, identify the C history record, and assemble the source file. Then collect 3 crystal(s) and reach the beacon. In C, initialize file-scope int cargo to 23. Inside a nested block declare a double cargo set to half your shipment trace and print it to one decimal place. After that block, print the restored file-scope cargo as an integer.
controls: Write int main(void) with declarations, assignments, printf and braces. Movement calls moveRight(n), moveLeft(n), moveUp(n), moveDown(n) are game helpers from logicade.h. Run or Step verifies real map goals, printed values and global state in the documented safe C subset. Use the expedition panel to place flowchart symbols, enter the trace, read the archive record, and assemble the source blocks.
win_condition: Verify the preparation checks and complete the coded expedition.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Program Assembler' (Week 9 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cactus Flats'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Place the shipment flowchart blocks and predict the extra input.
Read the historical record and assemble the C source file.
Write the scoped C program, collect the crystals, and reach the beacon.
source_player_objective: Protect the bazaar gate from dust devils in Cactus Flats: keep the program_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: program_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
hint: Work through the expedition checks in the sidebar. When writing C, declare the outer cargo before main and put the decimal cargo inside its own braces.
